scope: The installer repairs duplicate Docks and top bars and restores transparent menu bars on existing two-monitor layouts.

checks.command: Golden Gate installer_backend.py install with layout reset, then install with reset_layout=false starting from four top bars and three Docks. Both installer processes exited 0.
After VM reboot, read active containments: one shared Dock, two transparent top bars, original IDs and ten original pins retained. Compared the two-monitor captures.

captures.environment: KDE neon, Plasma 6.8.1, Wayland, two outputs, Golden Gate

coverage_limits: Golden Gate VM exercised the shared panel code. Tahoe was not separately booted. The live scripting API retained the previous widget width until reboot. Captures show it hidden right after reinstall. The post-boot width was zero.
